newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle sales brisk $63 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle sales brisk $63 - USDA.

text.p: with slaughter steers and heifers steady, USDA said.
Wk to date- 48,700 last week - 40,000 last year - 14,400
Slaughter steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1100-1310 lbs
63.00, pen 62.50; few 1050 lbs with light end 62.00.

Slaughter heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1000-1140 lbs 63.00; few Select with end Choice *63.00; few mixed Commercial to Choice 1100-1125 lb heifers and heiferettes *61.00-63.00; pen Select and Choice 980 lb heifers 62.50.

Inquiry good, demand moderate. Sales confirmed on 17,600 slaughter steers and 15,400 slaughter heifers Tuesday. For the week to date 48,700 head confirmed including 13,100 head or about 27 percent previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
